question: The novel ‘God of Small Things’ is a creation of which novelist?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arundhati Roy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The novel **'God of Small Things'** is written by **Arundhati Roy**.
 
• It was first published in **1997** and won the **Booker Prize** in the same year.
 
• The novel is set in the state of **Kerala, India**, and explores the social issues and class relations in Indian society.
 
• 'God of Small Things' is known for its rich prose and intricate narrative structure.
 
• Arundhati Roy is also recognized for her work as an **activist and essayist**, addressing various social and political issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arundhati Roy** was born on **24th November 1961** in Shillong, Meghalaya, India.
 
• Besides her literary work, she is noted for her activism on issues such as **environmentalism and human rights**.
 
• Her other notable works include **'The Ministry of Utmost Happiness'**, **'Field Notes on Democracy'**, and **'Capitalism: A Ghost Story'**.
 
• Roy's writing often addresses themes of **inequality, injustice, and the impact of globalization on local communities**.
 
• Her contributions to literature and social causes have made her a prominent figure both in India and internationally.
